findings.claim_attacked: OWNER_DECISIONS section 39 legitimately extends to GAP-RITUAL-005's offerings by analogy.

GAP-RITUAL-005 closes CLOSED_DERIVED with closure_citation: null AND closure_owner_decision: null. The audit downgrades CLOSED_SCOPE_DECISION with no citation to STILL_IMPLEMENTATION_FIXABLE (lines 2136-2142); CLOSED_DERIVED requires no citation at all. A scope reinterpretation recorded as a derived closure therefore passes the citation guard by not being subject to it. The same shape applies to ENTITY_COVERAGE-004, QUALITY-003, RITUAL-006 and TRANSLATION-004, all CLOSED_DERIVED with closure_citation: null. So: it is an agent-inferred extension of an owner decision, it does not formally close the entry (the derived measure does), and the ledger's 'AGENT-INFERRED can close nothing' rule is respected in letter while the substance of the closure rests on the extension.
findings.what_must_change: Either carry the section-39 citation in closure_citation so the guard applies, or record the entry as awaiting owner ratification of the extension.

findings.claim_attacked: build_index docstring: 'A registered alias containing whitespace goes to the PHRASE table and never to `token`.'
findings.what_i_measured: False -- there is no such routing. The aliases_sa loop at mentions.py:216-228 writes every alias to token[folded] regardless of whitespace, and appends it to `sandhi` whenever len(folded) >= MIN_SANDHI_ALIAS_CHARS. Phrases come only from the separate aliases_sa_phrases field, populated in concepts.py:566-573, which filters to strings containing a space. So a multi-word alias placed in aliases_sa still lands in the single-token table and matches nothing forever -- the exact defect GAP-ENTITY_COVERAGE-007's reason-still-open described -- and if fold_alias were ever to strip whitespace it would also enter the Samaveda substring pass. No entity currently does this, so the hazard is latent. The accompanying test documents the hazard rather than preventing it.
findings.what_must_change: Enforce the stated invariant: skip whitespace-bearing aliases in the aliases_sa loop and route them to the phrase table, or raise.
